definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a theory, field of study, or systematic discussion about a topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧{論|ろん}⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I studied the theory of evolution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{論|ろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has his own economic theory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧{論|ろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Attached to nouns to form names of theories, academic fields, or types of discourse.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧{論|ろん} (theory of evolution)
- ⟦{相対性|そうたいせい}→相対性：26142_soutaisei⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧ (theory of relativity)
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{論|ろん} (economic theory)
- ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧{論|ろん} (linguistics)
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧{論|ろん} (methodology)
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧/⟦{世論|せろん}→世論：05315_seron⟧ (public opinion)
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧{論|ろん} (opposing argument)
- ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧{論|ろん} (supporting argument)

NOTE: {論|ろん} by itself can mean 'argument' or 'theory'. The suffix creates compound nouns.
